label: right-v3

request.prompt: Perform a strict transparent-background removal/cutout of these sixteen FROSTBITE creature sprites. REMOVE EVERY PIXEL of coloured aura, red light haze, cyan haze, grey fog, blurry light and cast shadow outside the HARD PHYSICAL BODY. Preserve only the opaque painted dark shell and grey ribbon tentacles with attached crystalline red/cyan tips and crisp antialiased edges. All visual glow and fog are background contamination to delete, INCLUDING the blurry red/cyan pools immediately beside tentacle tips. Detached blurry colours must become true alpha0. KEEP the sixteen original complete distinct poses, 4×4 sheet, connected ribbons and attached solid tips, same direction and palette on actual creature body. Do not enhance glow or lights. Produce true transparent RGBA with opaque body and totally empty transparent background/gutters, a clean cutout sprite sheet with no halo. Each creature must look sharply cut out around its real physical contour.

output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-c7681c34-13af-4020-9677-c8a09fac44e7.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
